guide.summary: Lets a well-fed grazer leave spare food in a small store that slowly feeds the area.
guide.biology: Some real animals store extra food in one place, and those stores feed other creatures as they break down.
guide.rules: Costs 0.02 energy per second while carried. When active with more than 40 energy and a meal larger than 1.50 times its starting body, it moves up to 0.02 × starting body per second from the meal into a cache in its cell, always keeping at least 1.00 times its starting body in the meal. Creating a cache costs 2 energy once, and each carbon stored costs 0.10 energy. A cell holds one cache of up to 4 carbon, shared by every carrier. From the next tick the cache releases up to 0.02 carbon per second as local detritus; empty caches disappear. Amoeba, Ciliate, Shellglider and Dartfin can use it only while also carrying Debris feeder; Wheelgrazer does not need it.
guide.example: Let cache-making Amoebas feast on a Sprinter bloom, then watch Recyclers gather around the caches they leave.
